title: H5 with a learned net2: students trained on a net1 without TCP cross flows, on it and on net1 v7
description: Run 292 (exp-net2-r30-notcp-292) trained net1 v7's recipe on no episode with a TCP cross flow (net1 x, scalers and bins of net1 v7) and round 29's DAgger net2 on it, seeds 1 to 3. Each of those students at iteration 39 (round 29's chosen iteration, fixed before the results) runs unchanged on net1 x (net2-x-sN) and on net1 v7, the repaired net1 (net2-x-v7-sN; experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py --net1), beside round 29's students on net1 v7 (net2-v7-sN, model-truth-patch-src) and the fixed rule at u = 0.25 on each net1 (rule-x, rule-v7). Validation links at campaign seed 21 (the five families) and 2 and 4 copies. Criterion, stated in run 292 before the results: H5 holds if on net1 v7 the students recover at least half of the five-family gap, mean over three seeds, between themselves on net1 x and round 29's students on net1 v7, with no family worse than on net1 x by more than 0.02. If they lose instead, they learned to make up for net1 x's errors (H4 fails). Nothing is chosen.
prepare: (cd "$IN/t" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); declare -A N=([v7]="$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" [x]="$IN/r/net1-notcp/net1.pt"); P=(); for k in v7 x; do uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/rule-$k" "${N[$k]}" --u 0.25; P+=(--policy "rule-$k=$OUT/rule-$k/rule-u0.25.onnx"); done; for s in s1 s2 s3; do d="$OUT/runs/r29-$s"; mkdir -p "$d"; cp "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" "$d/net1.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-$s.actor.pt" "$d/actor.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-$s.ppo_spec.json" "$d/ppo_spec.json"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7-$s" "$d" --t 0.5; P+=(--policy "net2-v7-$s=$OUT/p/net2-v7-$s.onnx"); r="$IN/r/ppo-r30-means-s${s#s}"; d="$OUT/runs/r30-$s"; mkdir -p "$d"; cp "${N[x]}" "$d/net1.pt"; cp "$r/iter039/actor.pt" "$d/actor.pt"; cp "$r/ppo_spec.json" "$d/ppo_spec.json"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-x-$s" "$d" --t 0.5; P+=(--policy "net2-x-$s=$OUT/p/net2-x-$s.onnx"); uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-x-v7-$s" "$d" --t 0.5 --net1 "${N[v7]}"; P+=(--policy "net2-x-v7-$s=$OUT/p/net2-x-v7-$s.onnx"); done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 22 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s && for s in s1 s2 s3; do uv run python experiments/versus_rule.py "$OUT" "net2-x-$s"; done && uv run python experiments/versus_rule.py "$OUT" rule-x
